axeViolations.description: Ensure elements have alternative text or a role of none or presentation

axeViolations.help: Zooming and scaling must not be disabled
axeViolations.html: <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, minimum-scale=1.0, maximum-scale=1.0, user-scalable=no">
